name: Google SERP Scraper
description: Premium Google Search scraper with organic, ads, AI overview, and map pack extraction via mobile proxies.
longDescription: The most robust Google SERP scraping service designed for AI agents. Built with Python/Playwright and specifically tuned for real 4G/5G mobile carrier networks. Extracts organic results, sponsored ads (top/bottom), People Also Ask (PAA), Featured Snippets, AI Overviews (SGE), Knowledge Panels, Map Pack results, and Related Searches. All results are returned as structured JSON. x402 payment gate ensures seamless pay-per-request usage without API keys.
